name: Drei Grafen
beschreibung:
Peacefully situated in Bruckhaeusl, the traditional Gasthof Drei Grafen welcomes holidaymakers and travellers with genuine Tyrolean warmth. Its comfortable rooms ensure restful nights after outdoor adventures.

The surrounding Hohe Salve region impresses with direct access to the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental, riverside cycle paths, and panoramic alpine hiking trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Drei Grafen in Bruckhaeusl provides welcoming family charm and an ideal base in the Hohe Salve holiday region.
